operations.title: A stick-figure man (Spyder Math style) standing at a cha
operations.code:
from manim import *

class GeneratedScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # ---- Ground ----
        ground = Line([-6.5, -3.3, 0], [6.5, -3.3, 0], color=GREY_BROWN, stroke_width=5)

        # ---- Stick-figure man (Spyder Math style), drawing/casting pose ----
        head = Circle(radius=0.38, color=WHITE, stroke_width=4).move_to([-3.2, -0.2, 0])
        body = Line([-3.2, -0.58, 0], [-3.2, -2.1, 0], color=WHITE, stroke_width=4)
        arm_back = Line([-3.2, -0.58, 0], [-3.9, -1.3, 0], color=WHITE, stroke_width=4)
        arm_extended = Line([-3.2, -0.58, 0], [-0.6, 0.1, 0], color=WHITE, stroke_width=4)
        leg1 = Line([-3.2, -2.1, 0], [-3.2, -3.3, 0], color=WHITE, stroke_width=4)
        leg2 = Line([-3.2, -2.1, 0], [-2.8, -3.3, 0], color=WHITE, stroke_width=4)
        man = VGroup(head, body, arm_back, arm_extended, leg1, leg2)

        # ---- Circle geometry ----
        center = np.array([1.6, 0.1, 0])
        radius = 2.2

        center_dot = Dot(center, color=YELLOW, radius=0.09)
        center_label = MathTex("O", color=YELLOW, font_size=36).next_to(center, DOWN, buff=0.18)

        # ---- Arc traced from the hand ----
        alpha = ValueTracker(0)

        arc = always_redraw(
            lambda: Arc(
                radius=radius,
                start_angle=PI,
                angle=alpha.get_value(),
                arc_center=center,
                color=WHITE,
                stroke_width=5,
            )
        )

        def arc_end():
            a = PI + alpha.get_value()
            return center + radius * np.array([np.cos(a), np.sin(a), 0])

        tip = always_redraw(lambda: Dot(arc_end(), color=WHITE, radius=0.06))
        chalk = always_redraw(
            lambda: Line([-0.6, 0.1, 0], arc_end(), color=GREY_A, stroke_width=3)
        )

        self.add(arc, tip, chalk)

        # ---- Animation ----
        self.play(FadeIn(ground), FadeIn(man), run_time=1.8)
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(center_dot), FadeIn(center_label), run_time=1.0)
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(alpha.animate.set_value(2 * PI), run_time=6.0, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(1.5)
